updates.from:
Nanobeasts turns walking into a creature collection game.

Every step helps hatch new eggs, evolve Nanobeasts, and grow your research lab. Set a daily step goal, build streaks, unlock badges, and watch your collection expand as you move.

Inside Nanobeasts you can:
- Hatch and evolve creatures by walking
- Track steps, streaks, distance, calories, and active minutes
- Explore your growing Dex and revisit discoveries
- Review progress in a stats dashboard with badges and history
- Use reminders to stay consistent with your walking habit

Premium unlocks deeper collection progress, new weekly creature drops, custom lab colors, and Apple Health syncing for more complete tracking, including Apple Watch activity.

Nanobeasts is built to make walking feel more rewarding, more consistent, and a lot more fun.

Privacy Policy: https://nanobeasts.app/privacy
Terms of Use: https://nanobeasts.app/terms
updates.to:
Turn your daily steps into a growing creature collection.

Walk to hatch eggs, evolve Nanobeasts, and discover new companions. Set a daily step goal, build streaks, collect badges, and explore your Field Dex.

YOUR MOVEMENT, AT A GLANCE
Track steps and activity with Apple Health. Review your progress, history, and milestones on iPhone.

TAKE YOUR COMPANION ON A WALK
The Apple Watch app puts your current creature or egg beside your step progress. See your weekly steps, hourly activity, distance, active energy, and exercise time. Swipe to choose a workout and follow live stats as you move.

REMEMBER THE JOURNEY
Record outdoor walks and other supported workouts. Review your workout time, steps, distance, pace, and active energy on iPhone. With location and route recording enabled, see where you went and share a workout summary.

MAKE IT YOURS
Choose your daily goal and reminders, and find privacy information and subscription management in Settings.

Nanobeasts Pro removes the free daily creature-progression limit. Apple Health activity tracking remains available without Pro. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled through your App Store account.

Privacy Policy: https://nanobeasts.app/privacy
Terms of Use: https://nanobeasts.app/terms
